name: Incendium
author: Lewis Bayfield

sections.description:
Incendium gives you a clear, end-to-end view of your site’s performance. Track every visit, action, and outcome. Attribute results with confidence, beat tracking blockers, and unlock deeper insights. Launch A/B tests, optimize flows, and generate reports—all in one place.

This plugin connects your WordPress site with the Incendium analytics platform, providing seamless integration for tracking and analysis. Visit incendium.ai to learn more.

Key Features

  • Tracking: patent pending tracking captures more data so you make more accurate decisions
  • Impactial attribution: get attribution you can trust, and customise your own models
  • AB testing: test optimization changes and action your insights
  • LTV Analysis: forecast lifetime customer value to enhance decision-making.
  • Reporting & dashboards: make sure everyone in your team has the data they need with unlimited custom dashboards
  • WooCommerce support: automatic set up to track product, cart, and checkout behavior instantly

Getting Started

  1. Sign up for an Incendium account at incendium.ai
  2. Go to the Integrations page in your Incendium dashboard
  3. Click “Connect WordPress” to get your environment and project key
  4. Install and configure this plugin with your credentials

Contributors & Development

The Incendium WordPress plugin is developed and maintained by the Incendium team.

Contributing

While this plugin is open source under GPL, it is primarily maintained by Incendium. If you encounter any issues:

  1. Report them through our support channels at incendium.ai
  2. Ensure you have an active Incendium subscription
  3. Include your WordPress version and plugin version in any bug reports

Support

For technical support and questions:
* Visit incendium.ai
* Contact our support team through your Incendium dashboard
* Email: support@incendium.ai
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/incendium directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Incendium menu item to configure the plugin settings
  4. Enter your environment and project key from your Incendium dashboard

Required Credentials

This plugin requires two pieces of information from your Incendium account:
* Environment – Available in the Integrations > WordPress section
* Project Key – Available in the Integrations > WordPress section
sections.faq:
Do I need an Incendium account?

Yes, this plugin requires an active Incendium subscription to function. Visit incendium.ai to learn more about pricing and sign up for an account.

How do I get my project key?

  1. Log in to your Incendium dashboard
  2. Go to Integrations > WordPress
  3. Click “Connect WordPress”
  4. Your environment and project key will be displayed
